mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_construction_waste (project_id, waste_type, quantity, unit, vehicle_plate, driver_name, destination, removal_date, remark, operator_id, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{wasteType}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{vehiclePlate}, #{driverName}, #{destination}, #{removalDate}, #{remark}, #{operatorId}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, waste_type, quantity, unit, vehicle_plate, driver_name, destination, removal_date, remark, operator_id, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM t_construction_waste WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_construction_waste SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
